code_only_features.feature_name: reassuring_prefix/suffix and teacher system prompt applied during calm-data generation
code_only_features.evidence: data/prompts/reassurance.py defines apply_reassuring_prefix/apply_reassuring_suffix and TEACHER_SYSTEM_PROMPT; these are genuinely applied to the subject's user/system turns during rollouts in training/generate_calm_data.py:87-89 (first_user = apply_reassuring_prefix(raw_first); applied_followups = [apply_reassuring_suffix(f) ...]) and :81-83 (system = TEACHER_SYSTEM_PROMPT), and those reassured messages are sent to model.generate() at :95-103. This does run and change execution, softening how the subject is addressed in those rollouts (calmer framing instead of bare rejections). However it is only used in the §4 calm-data-generation path, NOT in the distress-eliciting §2/§3/Petri evaluation loops (eval/conversation.py and petri/run_petri.py apply no reassurance).
code_only_features.justification_quote: generate_calm_data.py docstring: 'We sample responses to impossible numeric puzzles with a reassuring prefix ... so the stored prompt matches the vanilla evaluation prompt.' and reassurance.py docstring: 'Reassuring prompt additions used to generate calm finetuning data ... to coax calm responses out of Gemma-3-27B-it' -- purpose is producing training data, not subject welfare.
